import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.nextLine();

        int index_of_dot = s.substring(1, s.length() - 1).indexOf("dot");
        while (index_of_dot != -1) {
            index_of_dot += 1; // Adjust for substring starting at index 1
            s = s.substring(0, index_of_dot + 1) + '.' + s.substring(index_of_dot + 3);
            index_of_dot = s.substring(1, s.length() - 1).indexOf("dot");
        }

        int index_of_at = s.substring(1, s.length() - 1).indexOf("at");
        index_of_at += 1; // Adjust for substring starting at index 1
        s = s.substring(0, index_of_at + 1) + '@' + s.substring(index_of_at + 2);

        System.out.println(s);

    }
}
